title: Applying the rules in An-Nazi'at 25 to 32: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Applying the rules in An-Nazi'at 25 to 32 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 28. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ (٢٥) إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ (٢٦) ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا (٢٧) رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا (٢٨) وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا (٢٩) وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ (٣٠) أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا (٣١) وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا (٣٢)

head: Words
Where
Rule
rows: Idgham without ghunnah: tanween into ل

questions.a: مَن يَخْشَىٰٓ: idgham with ghunnah (ن into ي); يَخْشَىٰٓ at a stop: 'arid madd with a maddah sign.

questions.q: Rule map (pupil PDF): label six rules in 79:25 to 32. Today's rota group recites 79:17 to 24.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher sheet, for example: heavy laam of Allah (79:25), idgham without ghunnah (79:26), muttasil (79:27, 79:31), heavy غ and ط (79:29), 'arid madds at the ayah ends.

questions.q: Extend: recite 79:25 to 32 to a partner, who ticks each rule.
questions.a: Partner ticks each rule; one target given.

questions.q: Stretch: what are the signs of creation listed in 79:27 to 32?
questions.a: The sky raised and proportioned, night and daylight, the earth spread out, water and pasture, the mountains set firm.

questions.q: «فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ» (79:25): the laam of Allah is ...
questions.a: A) heavy. After the dammah on ه the laam is heavy.

questions.q: The first check on a new passage in our routine is ...
Think again: When you read a new passage, which rule do you look for first? Why?
questions.a: Many look for madd first because it changes the length of every ayah end; others start with noon sakinah.
